guides.title: Configure sign-in and the dashboard of a project on the database ORM
guides.summary: A project with the auth or dashboard feature mounts the sign-in pages, the dashboard, the auth module and the services from @cossackframework/dashboard and holds no copy. It states its choices in src/dashboard.config.ts (DashboardConfig: authMethods, oauth, modules, dashboard, redirectAfterLogin) and keeps its schema: models, migrations and seeders.
guides.markdown:
The sign-in pages (`/auth/login`, `/auth/register`, `/auth/forgot-password`, `/auth/reset-password`, `/auth/two-factor`), the OAuth routes (`/auth/<provider>/redirect` and `/callback`), the dashboard (`/dashboard`, users, roles, sessions, profile), the auth module and the services are served from `@cossackframework/dashboard`. The project names the package in `package.json` (`"cossack": { "packages": ["@cossackframework/dashboard"] }`). Do not look for `src/auth.ts`, `src/pages/auth/`, `src/pages/dashboard/`, `src/dashboard/`, `src/services/users.ts` or `src/middlewares/auth.ts` in the project, and do not create them to change behaviour.

The project holds:

- `src/dashboard.config.ts`, which exports `dashboard: DashboardConfig`. `authMethods` is `['credentials']`, `['oauth']` or both (`AuthMethod`). `oauth` lists the providers (`OAuthProviderName`: `github`, `google`, `gitlab`, `facebook`, `microsoft`); each reads `<PROVIDER>_CLIENT_ID` and `<PROVIDER>_CLIENT_SECRET`, and `OAUTH_SECRET` signs the state. `modules` lists the dashboard's modules (`DashboardModuleName`: `users`, `sessions`, `settings`, `roles`). `dashboard: false` is sign-in without a dashboard. `redirectAfterLogin` is where a completed sign-in goes; the `AUTH_REDIRECT_AFTER_LOGIN` variable replaces it. A page of something that is off answers 404.
- its schema: `src/models/` (`User`, `Session`, `Role`, `UserRole`, `OAuthAccount`), `src/migrations/` and `src/seeders/`. The served code reads the models as `@/models/<Name>`, so keep their names and fields; add fields and models of your own beside them.
- `src/bootstrap/middlewares.ts`, which spreads `authMiddlewares` from `@cossackframework/dashboard/app/middlewares/auth` after the ORM's request middleware.

In server code, import the auth module by package name: `import { auth, registerUser } from '@cossackframework/dashboard/app/auth'`. `cossack add auth`, `cossack add dashboard` and `cossack remove` change `src/dashboard.config.ts` with the recipe. To restyle or change one page, copy it into the project with `cossack eject dashboard /auth/login`; the copy overrides the package's page and `cossack upgrade` merges the package's later changes into it. Update with `pnpm cossack upgrade`: it changes dependencies only, and never the project's own files.
